## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe it clearly.
*(e.g., "I'm frustrated when I try to..." or "Currently, AsGuard does not support...")*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how the proposed feature or improvement would solve the problem described above.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered or implemented.

## Additional Context / Use Case
Add any other context, mockup designs, or details about the use case for this feature.
